decision_needed.question: The Student Fees fund spent 4,115 ('Extracurricular activity fees') and the General Fund received exactly 4,115 labelled 'Transfers' within nonrevenue receipts. Is it right to treat this as a transfer rather than spending/receipts?
decision_needed.recorded_as: Attempt 3: treated as a transfer at both levels. Top level: split out of 'Other' receipts (now 14,637) and the Other Governmental Funds part of 'Student support services' (now 211,028) into transfers_in/transfers_out (165,000 + 4,115 = 169,115 each). Detail: General Fund +4,115, Student Fees -4,115 as other financing. Printed totals 5,499,101 / 4,649,510 kept, so receipts and disbursements items each sum to 4,115 less than the printed totals.

notes: Modified cash basis school district; all funds governmental (School Nutrition is a governmental fund here), no business-type funds. Receipts/disbursements from Total Governmental Funds column of the receipts, disbursements and changes in fund balances statement (p3); beginning/ending balances (3,230,258 / 4,079,849) from p4, equal to net position on p1-2. Transfers 165,000 in/out between General Fund and other funds net to zero in the total column (p4), not included in the printed totals. Attempt 3 (verifier fixes): Other local receipts 17,995 now split into Rentals 16,850, charges for services 1,054 (distance education) and other 91 (p7). The 4,115 Student Fees -> General Fund transfer (General Fund '5200 Transfers' p8; Student Fees 'Extracurricular activity fees' p16) is printed inside the statement's 'Other' receipts and 'Student support services' disbursements; it is split out of both and added to transfers_in/transfers_out (169,115 each, computed). The printed totals (receipts 5,499,101, disbursements 4,649,510) are kept as printed and include that 4,115 on both sides, so the receipts items sum to 5,494,986 and the disbursement items to 4,645,395; the fund-balance roll-forward is unchanged. Attempt 4: the split-out 4,115 on each side is recorded in reported_totals includes_split (receipts and disbursements) so the items plus the hidden transfer tie to the printed totals. Remaining 'Other' receipts 14,637 = insurance adjustment 197 + other nonrevenue 11,568 + non-program 2,523 (p8) + nutrition non-program 349 (p13). Debt services not split between principal and interest. Detail: General Fund recorded from the budget-and-actual schedule (pp7-10) rather than the combining schedule (pp5-6), which would double count; Depreciation and Employee Benefit columns in the combining schedule are covered by their own fund schedules (pp11-12). Hidden transfer: General Fund 'Non program' 247,654 includes 240,931 transfer to Depreciation Fund (eliminated in reclassification column, p6), recorded as other financing -240,931 with remainder 6,723 as expenditure; Depreciation 'General Fund support' 240,931 recorded as other financing +. Transfer-out budget figures are signed negative like their amounts. Depreciation Fund 'Improvements and equipment' relabelled 'Capital Outlay: Building and Grounds' (printed_label kept). GF Federal programs and State categorical programs assigned to instruction per reclassification column on p6. Budget amounts for Federal programs (135,000 group total) not assigned to lines. Lines with blank 2025 actual (e.g., Local fines and licenses, Career education, Employee Benefit disbursements) omitted. Student support services 409,593 split by the statement's own fund columns (p3): General Fund 194,450 as support services, Other Governmental Funds 215,143 = Activities 211,028 (student activities) + Student Fees 4,115 (transfer). State receipts 2,276,530 split using the fund schedules (GF p7 + Special Building p14) into Homestead Exemption 30,641, Property Tax Credit 1,128,694, Motor Vehicle Pro-Rate 6,953 and remaining state aid 1,110,242; County and ESU sources 32,752 split into 2110 Fines and licenses 8,194 and 2210 ESU 24,558. Balance sheet from the governmental funds Statement of Assets, Liabilities, and Fund Balances (p4, Total column), whose total 4,079,849 equals the government-wide net position (p2); no liabilities printed. Read pages 1-16 of 16.
